class.name: VECSObserver
class.brief_description:
A reactive, event-driven observer that reacts to component changes.
响应式、事件驱动的观察者，对组件变化做出反应。
class.description:
[b]VECSObserver[/b] subscribes to ECS events (component ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED, membership MATCHED / UNMATCHED, and custom events). When a matching event fires, the observer's callback runs — GDScript observers override [method _script_each], C++ observers override [code]_each[/code].
Subscribe to event kinds by calling the [code]on_*[/code] helpers (e.g. [method on_added]) or by setting [member events] as a bitmask. Filter by component type with [method set_components]; for MATCHED/UNMATCHED use [method set_match_components]. Register the observer with [method VECSWorld.add_observer].
[b]VECSObserver[/b] 订阅 ECS 事件（组件 ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED、成员 MATCHED / UNMATCHED，以及自定义事件）。匹配事件触发时执行观察者的回调——GDScript 观察者覆写 [method _script_each]，C++ 观察者覆写 [code]_each[/code]。
通过调用 [code]on_*[/code] 辅助方法（如 [method on_added]）或以位掩码设置 [member events] 来订阅事件类型。用 [method set_components] 按组件类型过滤；MATCHED/UNMATCHED 用 [method set_match_components]。用 [method VECSWorld.add_observer] 注册观察者。

method.name: _script_each
method.description:
GDScript override point, called for every subscribed event. [param event] is one of the [enum Event] values, [param entity] is the affected entity, [param payload] carries event-specific data (custom payloads, or empty for component events).
GDScript 覆写点，每个已订阅事件触发时调用。[param event] 是 [enum Event] 之一，[param entity] 是受影响的实体，[param payload] 携带事件特定数据（自定义载荷，组件事件则为空）。

method.name: get_components
method.description:
Returns the component filter set with [method set_components].
返回用 [method set_components] 设置的组件过滤器。

method.name: get_fields
method.description:
Returns the field-level Changed filter set with [method set_fields].
返回用 [method set_fields] 设置的字段级 Changed 过滤器。

method.name: get_match_components
method.description:
Returns the membership query set with [method set_match_components].
返回用 [method set_match_components] 设置的成员查询。

method.name: get_throttle_tick
method.description:
Returns the CHANGED throttle interval in change-clock ticks set with [method set_throttle_tick].
返回用 [method set_throttle_tick] 设置的 CHANGED 节流间隔（以变更时钟 tick 计）。

method.name: get_world
method.description:
Returns the [VECSWorld] this observer is attached to.
返回该观察者所挂载的 [VECSWorld]。

method.name: on_added
method.description:
Subscribes to ADDED events (a component was attached to an entity).
订阅 ADDED 事件（组件被挂载到实体上）。

method.name: on_changed
method.description:
Subscribes to CHANGED events (a component value was written).
订阅 CHANGED 事件（组件值被写入）。

method.name: on_custom
method.description:
Subscribes to custom events broadcast with [method VECSWorld.emit_event]. Combine with [member custom_event_name] to filter by event name.
订阅用 [method VECSWorld.emit_event] 广播的自定义事件。可结合 [member custom_event_name] 按事件名过滤。

method.name: on_matched
method.description:
Subscribes to MATCHED events (an entity entered the membership query set with [method set_match_components]).
订阅 MATCHED 事件（实体进入用 [method set_match_components] 设置的成员查询集合）。

method.name: on_removed
method.description:
Subscribes to REMOVED events (a component was detached or an entity was destroyed).
订阅 REMOVED 事件（组件被移除或实体被销毁）。

method.name: on_unmatched
method.description:
Subscribes to UNMATCHED events (an entity left the membership query set).
订阅 UNMATCHED 事件（实体离开成员查询集合）。

method.name: set_components
method.description:
Restricts the observer to events about the named components. Empty means "watch all components".
把观察者限制为只处理与所列组件相关的事件。为空表示"观察所有组件"。

method.name: set_fields
method.description:
Restricts CHANGED delivery to the named fields: only CHANGED events whose field name is in [param names] are delivered. Empty means "watch every field". Component-level changes (no field name) are skipped while the filter is non-empty. ADDED / REMOVED / MATCHED / UNMATCHED / custom events are unaffected.
把 CHANGED 派发限制为只处理所列字段：仅派发字段名在 [param names] 中的 CHANGED 事件。为空表示"观察所有字段"。过滤器非空时，组件级变更（无字段名）会被跳过。ADDED / REMOVED / MATCHED / UNMATCHED / 自定义事件不受影响。

method.name: set_throttle_tick
method.description:
Throttles CHANGED delivery using the world's monotonic change clock: at most one callback per [param ticks] change-clock ticks. This is a deterministic tick-based interval, not wall-clock time. Pass 0 (the default) to disable throttling.
用世界的单调变更时钟节流 CHANGED 派发：每 [param ticks] 个变更时钟 tick 最多回调一次。这是确定性的基于 tick 的间隔，而非墙钟时间。传 0（默认）关闭节流。

method.name: set_match_components
method.description:
Sets the component-set query for MATCHED / UNMATCHED membership events. The observer tracks which entities match the set and reports transitions.
为 MATCHED / UNMATCHED 成员事件设置组件集查询。观察者跟踪哪些实体匹配该集合并报告状态转换。

members.member:
When subscribing to custom events, only events with this name are delivered. Empty means all custom events.
订阅自定义事件时，只派发该名称的事件。为空表示所有自定义事件。

Bitmask of subscribed event kinds (the [enum Event] values as bits). Set it directly or use the [code]on_*[/code] helpers.
已订阅事件类型的位掩码（[enum Event] 值作为位）。可直接设置，或用 [code]on_*[/code] 辅助方法。

When to flush the deferred command buffer: [constant PER_CALLBACK] flushes after each event callback; [constant MANUAL] never auto-flushes (call [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush] yourself).
控制延迟命令缓冲的冲刷时机：[constant PER_CALLBACK] 在每个事件回调后冲刷；[constant MANUAL] 从不自动冲刷（自行调用 [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush]）。

constants.constant:
A component was added to an entity.
组件被添加到一个实体。

A component was removed from an entity, or the entity was destroyed.
组件从实体被移除，或实体被销毁。

A component value was written.
组件值被写入。

An entity started matching the membership query.
实体开始匹配成员查询。

An entity stopped matching the membership query.
实体停止匹配成员查询。

A custom event was broadcast with [method VECSWorld.emit_event].
用 [method VECSWorld.emit_event] 广播了自定义事件。

Flush the command buffer after each event callback.
在每个事件回调后冲刷命令缓冲。

Never auto-flush; call [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush] manually.
从不自动冲刷；手动调用 [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush]。
